answer: The jetty cap is enforced at intake and horizon shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a lotus tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The fee repeats 27 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
